verdict.rationale: Circle's CCTP documents triggering automated actions on the destination blockchain after assets arrive, which is a narrow, event-triggered automation built into the product. Webhooks only notify your app so it can react, and spending policies constrain transactions rather than trigger actions, so neither counts as a rules engine. Missing for 10: a general user-defined rule/trigger engine across event types, detail on how CCTP hook actions are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
